resources.string: These questions only cover a few passages, not the whole document, and they don\'t measure how much you know. You can see where each one comes from, but we haven\'t checked that it\'s correct.
Answer with what you know now. “I don\'t know yet” is fine. Tap an answer to go to the next question. This isn\'t a test: it only helps us decide where to start explaining.
We\'ll start with the ideas you weren\'t sure about. One right answer doesn\'t mean you\'ve learned the topic, and “I don\'t know yet” isn\'t counted as wrong.
This explanation was written in advance. You can type a question and it will be saved, but it can\'t answer yet.
AI explanations can be wrong. Open the original passage to check important claims.
That\'s every idea covered. You can keep asking, or go back to your files.
The quote only shows where this comes from. It doesn\'t prove the explanation is right.
That didn\'t work. %1$s Nothing you\'ve done is lost. Try again, or reload.
You\'re offline. You can see what\'s saved. Connect to the internet to get new replies.
This sample doesn\'t have an explanation yet. Its original text is below. Pick a course that has one, or add your own PDF.
This conversation has reached its limit of 40 questions and replies. Everything so far stays saved.

If you continue, this document is sent to the server shown below. It reads the text and prepares a few starting questions. This is a practice server with no real AI, so the questions are simple stand-ins. A different server might use a real AI.
This version of the app isn\'t connected to a server. You can still try the built-in example.
The document is uploaded and we\'ve read its text.
Writing a few questions about this document…
Can\'t continue. %1$s Check your internet and the file, then try again. A file that already went up won\'t be sent twice.
Cancel stops this screen. If the server already got your document, it keeps it; cancelling doesn\'t delete it.
Or try a separate example we wrote ourselves. It isn\'t made from the file you picked.
Practice questions are made separately. Your answers to the quick questions don\'t count as a score.
Written in advance for this course. Nothing is uploaded, no AI is used, and your answers stay on this phone.
A few quick questions, then an explanation that starts where you are. Written in advance; no upload, no AI.
What do you want to get out of this reading?
Pick anything that matters to you. It only changes the order we go through things in; nothing is skipped.
Saved on this phone. Without internet it can\'t change the explanation. With an AI explanation, it can steer what we cover.
Your note: “%1$s” (saved on this phone; this explanation can\'t use it)
Pinch to zoom, double-tap to reset
The original file isn\'t stored on this phone; this is its text. Have the PDF? Attach it to see the real pages.
Attach your copy of the original PDF to see the real page

This doesn\'t look like the same file this course was made from, so we can\'t mark passages on it. Showing its text instead. We expected %1$s, %2$s; this file is %3$s. If you downloaded the right file and still see this, the course needs updating on our side.
That file is over 20 MB. Showing its text instead.
That file isn\'t a PDF. Showing its text instead.
That file couldn\'t be read or kept. Showing its text instead.
PDF attached. We can\'t tell where this passage sits on the page, so its text is shown here.
This file couldn\'t be opened as a PDF. Please choose another PDF.
This PDF is over 20 MB. Please choose a smaller one, or split it into parts.
This PDF is locked with a password. Remove the password, then choose it again.
This PDF is made of pictures, so there is no text to read. Please choose a PDF where you can select the text.
We couldn\'t read this file. Save it to this phone, then choose it again.
